title: ML-Embed: Inclusive and Efficient Embeddings for a Multilingual World

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text embedding models across 17 language-specific Massive Text Embedding Benchmarks (MTEB) to measure and mitigate performance disparities between high-resource languages (e.g., English, Chinese) and historically under-represented/low-resource languages (e.g., Polish, Persian, Vietnamese).
